case_number: 2025 INSC 215; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Civil) No. 25394 of 2023)
summary: Bid mistake case; L-1 bidder quoted Rs.1,569 instead of Rs.1,569 crores due to alleged system error; BRO rejected correction, forfeited bid security; mistake patent, error obvious, prompt notice; doctrine of proportionality applied; equitable relief warranted; forfeiture inequitable; West Bengal State Electricity Board precedent relied upon; doctrine of mutual mistake and unilateral error considered; transparency vs. fairness balance; judicial restraint in contractual matters acknowledged.
legal_provisions_cited: West Bengal State Electricity Board v. Patel Engineering Company Limited and Others, (2001) 2 SCC 451
M/s Omsairam Steels & Alloys Pvt. Ltd. v. Director of Mines and Geology, BBSR & Ors., 2024 INSC 520
Coimbatore District Central Cooperative Bank v. Coimbatore District Central Cooperative Bank Employees Association and Another, (2007) 4 SCC 669
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; bid security not to be forfeited; bank guarantee to be released; BRO directed to proceed with next lowest bidder; costs to be borne by BRO.
